title: List tracked bills with their six steps, status and date.
rule: Draw each bill as chapter 11 draws a list of bills (Rule 11.5): its number and name lead the row, its six numbered steps run across, and its status follows in words with the date of the latest action. A bill that became law fills all six steps and says so with its date and law number (Rule 11.3). Give the date the whole list was checked in the title or measure line, since a tracker shows one day.
use_when: The reader asks where a set of bills or rules stands today, and what has happened to each, for the Track pillar.

use_instead.when: One bill’s full path with every date, on its own page
When each part of one law takes effect
How many items sit at each stage, with no single bill named

text: A reader tracking bills wants the same answer for each one: how far it has come, what happened last and when. The six marks answer the first at a glance, in the same shapes the reader meets on every Oath & Action tracker, and the dated words answer the rest.
why.basis: Design judgment, from the chart system our founder and editor approved in November 2026

builders: Form tracker-list: node work/build/chart-kit/oa-chart.mjs build s40, or copy specs/s40.json and point it at a new dataset; encode.step and encode.skipped give each bill’s steps, labels.steps their names.
